input.quote: IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT OR THE USE OR PERFORMANCE OF THE SOFTWARE EXCEED THE TOTAL AMOUNT ACTUALLY PAID BY CORIO HEREUNDER FOR THE TRANSACTION WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES TO DURING THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO THE FILING OF THE CAUSE OF ACTION TO WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES.
input.rationale: The cap is nominally mutual but its basis is illusory in practice: it is limited to amounts "actually paid" by Corio (paid, not paid or payable) and only for "the transaction which the liability relates to", which can reduce recovery against Commerce One to a fraction of twelve months' fees, with no monetary floor. Carve-outs are limited to Section 8 (Commerce One's IP indemnity); breach of confidentiality (Section 10), data protection/security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and infringement of the other party's IP all sit inside the cap. The redline sets the cap at the greater of twelve months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, adds the standard uncapped Excluded Claims, and confirms Corio's fee obligations are not damages subject to the cap. The mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages in the second sentence is left intact.

proposal.summary: Set cap at greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, and add standard uncapped carve-outs (Excluded Claims).
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We replaced the per-transaction "amounts actually paid" cap with our standard mutual cap of the greater of twelve months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, and added the usual Excluded Claims so that indemnification, confidentiality/data security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap. We can accept a straight twelve months' fees cap as a fallback if the USD 1,000,000 floor is an issue.

ops.oldText: EXCEPT FOR LIABILITY ARISING UNDER SECTION 8 OF THIS AGREEMENT, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT OR THE USE OR PERFORMANCE OF THE SOFTWARE EXCEED THE TOTAL AMOUNT ACTUALLY PAID BY CORIO HEREUNDER FOR THE TRANSACTION WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES TO DURING THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO THE FILING OF THE CAUSE OF ACTION TO WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES.
ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT OR THE USE OR PERFORMANCE OF THE SOFTWARE EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE BY CORIO HEREUNDER DURING THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (B) ONE MILLION U.S. DOLLARS (US$1,000,000). "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS UNDER SECTION 8, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. CORIO'S OBLIGATION TO PAY FEES DUE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT BE TREATED AS DAMAGES SUBJECT TO THIS LIMITATION.
